_why: session_golden.json pins the SessionRecord struct in crates/gnomon-exec/src/main.rs.
Measured 2026-09-02: nothing in the shipped harness writes that struct.
`gnomon-exec` has no subcommand that emits a SessionRecord — `step` prints one
bare step object and `validate` only reads. The one command that writes a session
SessionManager in packages/gnomon-core/src/session.ts), and it writes a different
shape. Feeding a real `gnomon session` record to the only validator in the tree:
Error loading session: Deserialization error: missing field `seq` at line 65 column 7
So this file declares BOTH shapes and the subset that is actually contracted.
.gnomon/ci.sh checks a LIVE `gnomon session` record and session_golden.json against
it, so neither producer can drift without CI saying which key moved.

contract._why: docs/CONTRACTS.md section 4. Both producers must satisfy this.

gnomon-exec SessionRecord._written_by: nothing shipped; build_session() is reachable only from tests

divergence._why: Published rather than left to be discovered. Each entry is a real gap.
divergence.consequence: gnomon-exec validate --session cannot read a gnomon session record.
